questions.explanation: Five alternations give ten attacks and the final written note adds one, so 11 total. Missing the final note gives 10.
questions.hint: Two attacks per alternation plus one.

questions.learningObjective: State how much time an appoggiatura borrows
questions.stem: In an engineer's design brief, an appoggiatura precedes a half note. How much of the main note's value does it borrow?

options.text: Exactly half of the main note's value
Most of the main note's value
None of the main note's value
All of the following note's value

questions.explanation: An appoggiatura takes most of the main note's value. A fixed half or none contradicts the definition.
questions.hint: Appoggiatura steals most of the time.

questions.topic: The total time consumed by a turn
questions.learningObjective: Compute the total time consumed by a turn
questions.stem: In an engineer's design brief, a turn occupies one whole note and its four notes share the time equally. How many beats does each note receive if the whole note equals 4 beats?
questions.explanation: Four beats divided among four equal notes gives 1 beat each. Dividing by two would give two beats, too long.
questions.hint: Divide the note value by four.
